# Tara Handmade

Handmade demi-fine jewellery — earrings, necklaces, bracelets and rings — shaped, polished and finished by hand in a small studio in Jaipur, India. Prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and include GST.

## How to buy

- Each product page above has an "Add to cart" link that opens `/buy/<product-slug>/`, a plain cart page showing the item, price and quantity.
- From the cart page, follow the "Checkout" link to `/checkout/<product-slug>/`. That checkout link is shareable: it opens on any device with the item already in the order summary, no cookies needed, and shows the shipping form.
- The regular checkout page `/checkout.html?items=<slug>:<qty>` also accepts items in the URL (for example `/checkout.html?items=moti-pearl-strand:1`).
- Orders are confirmed personally on WhatsApp with a UPI payment link. Demo store: no real orders, payments or deliveries.
